response.rationale: The order is still in transit (status "in_transit"), so it has not been delivered and days_since_delivery is null. The standard return window (RET-007) requires delivery within the last 30 days, which cannot be satisfied since the item hasn't been delivered. No higher-priority rule applies: not final_sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051). A return cannot be processed for an item that has not yet arrived; the customer must wait until delivery to be eligible under RET-007.
